# ContextPill

A small chip that names the student's current context with a colour, an icon and the exact label.

`CLR.ContextPill` · Live state

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.ContextPill context="deep_focus" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.ContextPill" context="deep_focus"></x-import>
```

## Props (ContextPillProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context` * | `"deep_focus" \| "shallow_work" \| "stuck" \| "fatigue" \| "recovering" \| "unknown"` |  |
| `label` | `string` | Override the label. Default is the exact domain label ("Deep focus", "Warming up"…). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` |  |
| `uncertain` | `boolean` | Outlined, dashed border. Use when confidence < 0.5. |
| `plain` | `boolean` | Text-only, no fill (inside tables and dense lists). |
